d:
Did you know that you can stand on a beach in the USA while looking at Siberian mountains in the distance? Welcome to what feels like the end of the world - Gambell, Alaska! I've been wanting to visit this remote American island and indigenous community for quite some time, and I'm beyond excited to share their incredible life and culture with you!
Huge thanks to Wallace for showing me around Gambell! Check out his YouTube channel where he'll take you deeper inside Gambell:
I wrote a book called JUST GO, with exclusive travel stories & tips to inspire your next adventures!
